exposure: knowledge of early initiation of breastfeeding benefits
outcome: knowledge of early initiation of breastfeeding benefits
finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding was practiced by less than two-thirds of the study subjects, and significant factors promoting early initiation of breastfeeding included maternal education, higher age at marriage, vaginal/vaginal assisted delivery, and term/post-term baby.
mod_finding: Vaginal/vaginal assisted delivery was found to be a significant factor promoting early initiation of breastfeeding.
